name: Tempester n°61: the beat roll reads its window as a ring
explanation: Tempester n°61: the beat roll no longer loses notes pushed past the edge of a repetition (Main 1.5.0.2). Docs/analyses/feature-roll-swing.md §6. Before: [routine] (Timer 4) reads the events of the source steps c-3 .. c+1 around the source position c (the step of b0c + (x - b0c) % W while the roll is on). An event of the window whose played tick is folded into the next repetition (swing, Time Shift: a late note in the last step of a 1/16 window) is due when c is back at the start of the window: its step is then W/8 - 1 or - 2 steps ahead of c, never read, and the note is lost (1.6.4.0 included). After: while the roll is on ([address] != 0) and the window starts and ends on steps (b0c and W multiples of 8, at least 3 steps: windows of 1 or 2 steps are read whole already), [routine] reads, after the five usual steps, each step c + i (i = -3 .. +1) that falls outside the window again at its place inside the window (c + i +/- W/8), when that place is not one of the five already read. The window is read as a ring, as its repetitions are; the steps outside the window are still read as before. Roll off: the five steps as before. Hooks: [address] (jal [routine](i, c)) goes through RS_WRAP: i <= 1 as before, i = 2 .. 6 (the extra passes, i - 5 = -3 .. +1) the window step RS_MAP gives; [address]-[address] (the loop test "slti s3,s1,2 / bne") jump to RS_BOUND, which runs i = -3 .. +1 as before, then, roll on, the extra passes that RS_MAP accepts, then the epilogue [address]. Context: Timer 4 ([routine]). RS_BOUND is reached by j inside [routine], whose ra is saved at 0x5c(sp) and reloaded at [address], so its jal of RS_MAP is safe. Leaf routines without stack; they write only v0, a0, t0-t8 and s1 / s3 as the original loop does. No division, no RAM of its own.

edits.why: jal 0x9d07bd4c ; was "jal [address]" ([routine](i, c)); the delay slot "move a0,s1" is kept
j 0x9d07bd00 ; was "slti s3,s1,0x2": the loop test is made by RS_BOUND
nop ; was "bne s3,zero,[address]" (now in RS_BOUND); [address] "lw a1,0x1c(sp)" is done by RS_BOUND
as before: i < 2, one of the five usual steps
beq t2,zero,0x9d07bd44 ; roll off: the loop ends as before
lw a1,0x1c(sp) ; delay slot: c, the source position step
jal 0x9d07bd60 ; v0 = window step for the extra pass i, or -1
bgez v0,0x9d07bd3c ; a step to read: run the pass ([address] calls RS_WRAP, which gives the same step)
addiu s1,s1,0x1 ; delay slot: next extra pass
j [address] ; the loop body, as the original bne
j [address] ; [routine]'s epilogue, as the original fall-through
beq t0,zero,0x9d07bd60 ; extra pass: the window step (RS_MAP returns to [address])
lw t4,-0x64f4(t1) ; b0c, the window start
bne t5,zero,0x9d07bdf0 ; W not a whole number of steps (1/32: 12 ticks, read whole already)
bne t6,zero,0x9d07bdf0 ; window not starting on a step
srl t3,t3,0x3 ; delay slot: m = W / 8, steps in the window
bne t5,zero,0x9d07bdf0 ; 1 or 2 steps: inside the five steps read
srl t4,t4,0x3 ; delay slot: sb, the first step of the window
addu t7,t7,t3 ; delay slot: u before the window: w = u + m
bne t5,zero,0x9d07bdf0 ; u inside the window: read already
subu t7,t7,t3 ; u past the window: w = u - m
bne t5,zero,0x9d07bdf0 ; w before the window (window shorter than the reach): nothing
beq t5,zero,0x9d07bdf0 ; w past the window: nothing
bne t5,zero,0x9d07bde8 ; w before c - 3: not read yet
beq t5,zero,0x9d07bdf0 ; w in c - 3 .. c + 1: read already
or v0,t7,zero ; delay slot: the window step to read
li v0,-0x1 ; delay slot: no step
